newsitem.title: USA: Cabot Oil acquires West Virginia stake.
newsitem.headline: Cabot Oil acquires West Virginia stake.

text.p: Cabot Oil & Gas Corp said Monday it acquired half of Thronwood Gas Inc's interest in a project located primarily in eastern West Virginia for an undisclosed amount of cash.

Cabot Oil said it purchased a 50 percent working interest in six shut-in Oriskany wells, some 50,000 acres of leasehold, and 34 miles of 8 inch pipeline currently being built, and will become operator of the project.
The company said the pipeline will be connected to Columbia Gas System Inc and is expected to be completed by Dec 1.
The six wells should be turned in line soon thereafter with an initial daily flow rate of about 7.0 million cubic feet, Cabot said.

It said estimates show net proved non-producing reserves with development drilling opportunities of 2.85 billion cubic feet, net undeveloped reserves of 2.1 billion cubic feet and net probable reserves of 3.3 billion cubic feet.
In conjunction with this working interest, there are significant development and exploratory drilling opportunities based on previously shot seismic, Cabot's statement continued.
To highlight the significance of these opportunities, the net proved non-producing reserves quoted above are associated with only 4 percent of the leased acres, it continued.
Cabot said it intends to acquire additional seismic and drill both development and exploratory wells in 1997 in the vicinity of the new pipeline.

The new pipeline is also expected to stimulate drilling activity in the area by others and to provide marketing opportunities for Cabot related to the purchase and transportation of third party natural gas.
